name: Can I live in my home during a full kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: Can I live in my home during a full kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it is generally possible to live in your home during a full kitchen remodel, though it requires some adjustments. Your contractor will help establish a temporary cooking and washing station, often in a laundry room or garage. Be prepared for noise, dust, and limited access to certain areas during construction. We take measures to minimize disruption and maintain a tidy work environment, but flexibility is key.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, you can typically live in your home during a remodel, but prepare for noise, dust, and temporary cooking arrangements. Your contractor will help set up temporary solutions.
